description: common/mod.rs highlight() lowercases the entire remaining slice on every loop iteration (remaining.to_lowercase() inside loop). For a string with k matches each of length m in a haystack of length n, this is O(k*n) = O(n^2) time. For test infrastructure with short strings this is fine, but if highlight() is ever promoted to production code or called with larger inputs (e.g. full email body snippets), it will be slow. Fix: lowercase the haystack once before the loop and track byte offsets carefully, or use a crate like aho-corasick for multi-match search.
title: highlight() in common/mod.rs is O(n^2): relowercases entire remaining string each iteration
